Designed for hiking, travelling and outdoor adventures where every gram matters, the Touch Down Jacket is the lightest down jacket in our range. Don’t let its weight fool you, its expert panel stitching ensures that warmth is evenly dispersed throughout the body to keep you insulated when you need it most. This jacket is highly compressible and stuffs into its own separate stuff bag for lightweight travelling. An indispensable winter staple for any occasion.
  • 85/15 Duck Down Ratio with 650 Fill Power
  • Responsible Down Standard Certified
  • Microtex shell fabric
  • Hypoallergenic quality down that prevents allergic reaction
  • Highly compressible and packable into its own separate stuff bag
  • Exposed front zip with inner wind-stop zip flap
  • Invisible hand zip pockets for storage
  • Lip elastic cuff and hem seals in warmth
  • FA2391

The Men's Discovery 3-in-1 jacket combines superior comfort with unparalleled versatility. The Vapourtex waterproof outer shell with a mid-weight fleece inner ensures you're protected from the elements and kept comfortable on outdoor pursuits. The lightweight, adjustable hood offers added protection for your head, ears and neck and easily stows away into its own collar.
